project.name: breadcrumbs-rust
project.one_liner: A Bevy/wgpu 3D fly-through of NYC for BREADCRUMBS: extruded buildings + food-risk overlay + supplier hubs, with a free-flying game camera (the 'video-game feel' deck.gl can't match). Adapts the Sixth Borough renderer.
project.full_context: This is a PARALLEL, EXPERIMENTAL track. The deck.gl web console (globe/food3d.html on branch food) is the PRIMARY demo and the safe fallback; this Rust engine is upside only. Base = the Sixth Borough Bevy renderer copied to rust-engine/ (it COMPILES — target/ existed). Job: strip the Sixth Borough cultural/biography/year-scrubber specifics and adapt it to BREADCRUMBS food-safety data in rust-engine/data/ (buildings.json = Manhattan LiDAR extrusions [{p:[[lon,lat]...],h,y,b}]; restaurants.json = DOHMH graded establishments; distributors.json = supplier scorecard). Goal feel: fly THROUGH the city (free camera, WASD+mouse), neutral buildings, food-risk as color/markers, supplier hubs. Build/verify on the Mac (Rust 1.94, arm64); final demo runs on the GB10 (aarch64) — human-gated.
hard_rules: This is PARALLEL/experimental. Do NOT touch anything outside rust-engine/. The deck.gl console stays the primary demo.

Every milestone's gate is `cargo build --release` succeeding in rust-engine/ (a build that does not compile is never 'complete'). Where possible also run the binary headlessly to confirm it loads data without panic.

Adapt, don't rewrite from scratch — the base already compiles. Strip Sixth Borough specifics (biography/30B-model calls, immigration, ghost buildings, year scrubber) only as needed; keep the building extrusion + camera.
Data lives in rust-engine/data/*.json (already copied). Load from there; no network at runtime.
Comments minimal; the verification (cargo build + no-panic run) IS the test.
project.venue_notes: Runs off-box on the Mac (Rust 1.94) via this loop. Final GB10 aarch64 build + the FEEL are human-gated (Alex). Parallel to the food loop; deck.gl is the fallback.

milestones.name: Build gate — base engine compiles under Rust 1.94
tasks: cd rust-engine && `cargo build --release`. Fix any Rust-1.94 / Bevy-0.18 / edition-2024 drift so it compiles clean. Do NOT change behavior yet.
Note what the current main.rs does (data source, camera, what it renders) in RALPH.md for the next iteration.
verifications: the resulting binary exists at rust-engine/target/release/*

milestones.name: Load BREADCRUMBS buildings + render extruded Manhattan
tasks: Point the loader at rust-engine/data/buildings.json (schema [{p:[[lon,lat]...],h,y,b}]); project lon/lat to a local meter plane; extrude each footprint to height h. Neutral building material.
Strip Sixth Borough cultural/biography/immigration/year-scrubber code paths that block this.
verifications: running the binary with `--smoke` (add a headless flag that loads data, prints building count, exits 0) prints >=40000 buildings and does not panic

milestones.name: Food-risk overlay + supplier hubs
tasks: Load restaurants.json; render each as a small marker colored by DOHMH grade (A green / B amber / C red) OR a ground risk tint. Load distributors.json; place supplier hub markers sized by class1 recall count.
Keep buildings neutral; risk is the colored overlay (match the deck.gl 'neutral city + risk' language).
verifications: `--smoke` prints restaurant + hub counts (>=15000 restaurants, >=5 hubs) with no panic

milestones.name: Free-fly game camera + controls
tasks: Implement a free-flying camera: WASD move, mouse-look, shift=faster, scroll=speed. Smooth momentum. This is the 'movement' payoff.
Add a sensible spawn over Manhattan looking at the skyline.
verifications: the camera controller compiles and is wired into the Bevy app (assert the system is registered)

milestones.name: ON-BOX: GB10 aarch64 build + feel
tasks: Cross/native build for the GB10 (aarch64). Alex judges the movement/feel against the deck.gl console.
verifications: HUMAN-GATED: Alex builds+runs it on the GB10 and renders the verdict on whether it beats deck.gl. Loop prepares the build + notes and STOPS.
